product.name: Nile Access Service
product.description: A cloud-native wired and wireless LAN solution providing secure, automated network connectivity with AI-driven lifecycle management and zero trust security for enterprise campuses and branches.

product.name: Nile DHCP Service
product.description: A cloud-delivered Dynamic Host Configuration Protocol (DHCP) service that automates IP address management and eliminates the need for on-premises DHCP servers across enterprise networks.

product.name: Nile Services Cloud
product.description: A cloud platform that collects and analyzes network data to enable real-time observability, AI-driven automation, and continuous optimization of enterprise network infrastructure.

product.name: Nile Guest Service
product.description: A cloud-based service that isolates guest network traffic from corporate resources, providing secure and simplified guest access management across enterprise networks.
